prompt: After I press "Add to bag" on a product page I get "Added to your bag", but the Bag counter in the header stays at 0 until I navigate somewhere else or reload. Fix it so the header is right immediately.

truth.cause: The addToCart server action mutates the cart but never revalidates, so Next.js does not re-render the layout whose SiteHeader passes the count to CartButton.
truth.summary: Call revalidatePath('/', 'layout') after a successful add, as updateLineQuantity already does.

referenceFix.find:
const cartId = await requireCartId()
  return addCartLine(cartId, variantId, quantity)
